title: IBM Beats on Q2 Earnings: ETFs in Focus
description: After the closing bell on Jul 19, International Business Machines (IBM) reported mixed second-quarter 2023 results. It beat earnings estimates but lagged on revenues.

title: ETFs in Focus Post IBM's Q3 Earnings Beat
description: International Business Machines (IBM) reported strong third-quarter 2023 results. It beat estimates for earnings but missed the same for revenues. It affirmed its full-year outlook.

title: IBM Shares Surges Post Upbeat Q4: ETFs in Focus
description: IBM shares gained as much as 9.5% in the key trading session on Jan 25, 2024 as it beat on both lines in the fourth-quarter earnings.

title: Cisco Beats on Earnings, Trims Outlook: ETFs in Focus
description: Cisco (CSCO) beat estimates on both earnings and revenues but provided a weak outlook and revealed plans to lay off 5% of its global workforce, pushing its share price down.

title: ETFs in Focus Post IBM's Q1 Revenue Miss, HashiCorp Deal
description: International Business Machines (IBM) beat estimates for earnings but missed the same for revenues. Shares are declining following earnings announcement.. Also, IBM agreed to buy HashiCorp (HCP) for $35 per share in cash.

title: ETFs to Gain on Cisco's Q3 Earnings Strength
description: Cisco is on rise following the robust third-quarter fiscal 2024 results. ETFs with the largest allocation to this networking giant is also on the move.

title: Chemicals Company Dow Cuts Outlook Amid Production Challenges
description: Dow Inc. revised its Q3 revenue outlook downward to $10.6 billion due to a Texas ethylene cracker outage and higher input costs, though this was partly mitigated by improved pricing and feedstock costs in North America for its Packaging & Specialty Plastics segment.

title: Post-It Maker 3M Q3 Earnings: Sales Growth Slows, Margins Expand, Raises Annual Profit Outlook
description: 3M reported better-than-expected Q3 earnings, with adjusted EPS up 18% YoY and adjusted sales up 1.5%. The company revised its FY24 EPS guidance upward, despite slower sales growth. Margins expanded due to organic growth, productivity, and restructuring.

title: Dow Q3 Earnings: Volume Growth Amid Market Softness, Q4 Outlook Remains Cautious
description: Dow reported Q3 revenue growth of 1% year-over-year, beating estimates, but expects ongoing challenges in Europe and China in Q4. The company's cost-advantaged footprint in the Americas continues to provide a strong competitive edge.
